text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We can definitely hold our own even at 
middle distances. Having gained that 
confidence, Ikuno Dictus and her Trainer 
felt ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Oaks would be an even longer 
distance than today's race. She couldn't 
afford to let her guard down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Steel your resolve to implement solid 
countermeasures. All to ensure she can run 
the Oaks in top form—
